title: Resolve, to Direct the Board of Licensure in Medicine and the Board of Osteopathic Licensure to Conduct a Study Regarding the Feasibility of Combining Those Boards
committee_name: Health Coverage, Insurance and Financial Services

summary.text: This resolve directs the Board of Licensure in Medicine and Board of Osteopathic Licensure to conduct a study regarding the feasibility of combining into a single board that licenses and regulates physicians and physician assistants. The boards are required to submit a report based on the evaluation by December 31, 2025 to the Joint Standing Committee on Health Coverage, Insurance and Financial Services, which may submit legislation related to the report to the Second Regular Session of the 132nd Legislature.

status_label: Ought Not to Pass Pursuant To Joint Rule 310

final_disposition.label: Ought Not to Pass Pursuant To Joint Rule 310
